name: parity-levelchange
description: Wake Conquest then El Alamein Conquest, no bots, four slots, four-minute rounds: the level-change capture for the Kotlin sidecar's parity replay (tools/sidecar-android/parity/live/page-relay.mjs, features/sidecar-android-app/parity-audit.md). The page boards a Sherman on Wake, the round ends, the server restarts for El Alamein and the sidecar rejoins with the reconnect password, then the page deploys there. Small enough to commit.
human: No client: the Node sidecar through page-relay.mjs, seat_aim_probe.cjs and page-script.mjs; `lab.py stop` when the capture is done.
